name: Return to Onu
summary: You carry a page from the Twilight Tome back to Onu in Darkshore. The scribbles are all you could bear to take from the cultists’ book.

sections.title: A Glimpse into Madness
sections.body: The Twilight Tome overwhelms anyone who tries to read it. Its words swim across the page, and its ornate scrollwork twists into grotesque figures. You tear out a single page of scribbles before the strain brings on vertigo.

sections.title: Ancient Suspicions
sections.body: Onu, the Ancient of Lore, recognizes a strange aura in the page you bring him. Its chaotic, primal magic points to ancient, shadowy forces buried beneath the earth. The writing is hard to decipher, but it shows the Twilight's Hammer in Darkshore is pursuing more than banditry.

faq.q: What is the page taken from the Twilight Tome?
faq.answer: Insane Scribbles is a torn page from the Twilight Tome, the cult's sacred book. Its shifting script causes severe mental distress.
Onu is an Ancient of Lore in the Grove of the Ancients in southern Darkshore. He is an elder guardian and scholar who guides night elves and Alliance allies against corruption in the forest.

faq.q: What does Onu learn from the scribbles?
faq.answer: Onu senses chaotic, primal energy in the page and the influence of ancient, malevolent entities. The writings suggest the Twilight's Hammer cultists are pursuing relic sites and buried powers across Darkshore.

faq.q: Why is the Twilight's Hammer in Darkshore?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer came to Darkshore to excavate ruined elven sites and uncover traces of ancient power linked to primeval darkness and the Old Gods. The land's chaos helps hide their rites.

faq.q: Where does this investigation lead next?
faq.answer: Onu turns his attention to the ancient elven ruins of Mathystra to the north. He directs adventurers to secure the relics before the cultists can seize them.

faq.q: Why does reading the tome cause dizziness?
faq.answer: Dark, maddening magic fills the Twilight Tome. Its glyphs bewilder mortal minds, causing hallucinations and swoons that keep outsiders from understanding its secrets.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see the cultists' desecration of Darkshore's shores as a threat to the balance guarded by the Ancients of Lore. Onu's warnings strike close to home for the kaldorei.
As a druid, you recognize the scribbles' chaotic, unnatural resonance as an affront to the natural order you protect alongside treants like Onu.
As an Alliance member, you help investigate cult activity along Darkshore's coast and keep night elf settlements like Auberdine safe from hidden threats.
